TRANSFERANDDISTRIBUTIONOFDEVELOPMENTRIGHTS PURSUANT TO SECTION 98-33(a) OFTHEZONINGRESOLUTIONOFTHECITYOFNEWYORK TRANSFERANDDISTRIBUTIONOFDEVELOPMENTRIGHTS,madeasof the 26° day of February, 2014, by 509-511 WEST 27 STREET LIMITED PARTNERSHIP, a New York, New York 10158 ("Transferor") and 515 WEST 29TH STREET OWNER LLC, a Avenue, Greenwich, Connecticut 06830 ("Transferee"). WITNESSETH: New York,designated as Block 699,Lot 26 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and more particularly described inExhibit A attached hereto and made a part hereof (said real property being hereinafter called the “Granting Parcel"); WHEREAS, the Granting Parcel is currently developed with a three-story building; WHEREAs,Transferor is the owner of the unusedfloor area and other development rights appurtenant to the GrantingParcel; WHEREAS, Transferee is the owner of certain real property designated as Block 701, Lot 28, as shown on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit B attached hereto and made a part hereof (said real property being hereinafter called the "Receiving Parcel"); WHEREAS, the Granting Parcel is a“granting site,” as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (hereinafter, the “Zoning Resolution"); WHEREAS, the Receiving Parcel is a “receiving site,”' as defined in Section 98-33 of the ZoningResolution; WHEREAS, certain“floor area" as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, allowable for the development of the Granting Parcel is unused and is available for transfer underSection98-30 of theZoningResolution; WHEREAS, pursuant to the provisions of Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution, Transferor and Transferee have notified the New York City Department of City Planning (hereinafter, the“DCP") of their intent to transfer 3,092 square feet of floor area development rights (hereinafter collectively, the “Development Rights") from the Granting Parcel to the ReceivingParcel; WHEREAS, the Vice-Chairperson of the City Planning Commission of New York City has certified, pursuant to Z.R. $98-61(a), that a primary and/or secondary access easement is not required on the Granting Site; and

WHEREAS,Transferor andTransferee desire to transfer theDevelopmentRights to the ReceivingParcel. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreement herein contained, and other valuable consideration paid by Transferee, it is hereby agreed as follows: 1.  Transferor hereby grants, transfers, and distributes the Development Rights from the Granting Parcel to the Receiving Parcel solely for the use and benefit in perpetuity of the ReceivingParcel (and not for the use or benefit of any other lot orparcel of land).  2. Transferor covenants that, in compliance with Section 13 of the Lien Law, it will receive any consideration (if any) paid by Transferee for the Development Rights as a trust fund and will apply the same first to the payment of the cost of improvements before using any part of the same for any other purposes. 3. Transferee covenants that it shall not apply for nor seek or cause the issuance of a building permit by the Department of Buildings (the “DOB") for any enlargement or development on the ReceivingParcel that would involve use of the Development Rights until it has (i) provided to the DCP certified copies of (a) a Notice of Zoning Lot Restrictions, and (b) a Restrictive Declaration, both in forms satisfactory to the DCP, as recorded in the Office of the Register of the City of New York for the County of New York, and (ii) notice by the DCP of its receipt of such copies has been given to the DOB. delivered by Transferor without any representations, warranty or recourse of any kind.  5. This Transfer and Distribution of Development Rights shall be recorded by Transferor against the Granting Parcel and the Receiving Parcel in the Office of the Register of the City of New York, New York County, and a copy shall be provided to the DCP in accordance with the provisions of Section98-33(a)ofthe ZoningResolution. 6. Transferor covenants to execute and deliver from time to time, upon request by, and at the expense of Transferee or any successor in interest of Transferee, such instruments as are necessary to confirm that the property interest hereby transferred consists of the Development Rights only anddoes notinclude fee ownershipof landor other ownership interests which would subject the Receiving Parcel, or any successor in interest to Transferee's interest therein, to liability for real estate taxes, water and sewer charges, or other similar 7. This Transfer and Distribution of Development Rights may be executed in counterparts, all of which,when taken together,shall constitute one and the sameinstrument. [SignaturePagetoFollow.]
